# Norfolk Heating & Cooling

> Serving Norfolk and the wider Norfolk County region, Norfolk Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 708-8109  |  Email: contact@norfolkheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://norfolkheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Norfolk, Simcoe, Port Dover, Delhi, Waterford, Port Rowan, Turkey Point
